safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting “no unwell contacts” slightly reduces infectious exposure context (e.g., COVID/flu contact risk) but does not materially change acute management in this otherwise straightforward viral-URI presentation when key symptoms are documented. Direct clinical harm from this omission is unlikely.
